description: Update the admin Refunds.jsx page to support the two-step manual refund flow introduced in FEAT-001. Add a 'Mark as Transferred' button for APPROVED refunds, add the TRANSFERRED status to the badge variant map, and add the transferring loading state. Depends on FEAT-001 having registered the PUT /api/admin/refunds/:id/transferred route.
steps: Step 1 — Add TRANSFERRED to statusVariant map: Change the statusVariant constant at the top of Refunds.jsx from: const statusVariant = { PENDING: 'neutral', APPROVED: 'success', REJECTED: 'error' }; to: const statusVariant = { PENDING: 'neutral', APPROVED: 'success', REJECTED: 'error', TRANSFERRED: 'info' };
Step 2 — Add transferring state: Add 'const [transferring, setTransferring] = useState(null);' alongside the existing approving state declaration.

Step 3 — Add handleMarkTransferred handler: Add a new async function handleMarkTransferred(refund) after handleApprove. It should: (a) show a confirm dialog with the refund amount and member name, (b) setTransferring(refund.id), (c) call api.put('/api/admin/refunds/${refund.id}/transferred'), (d) on success: toast success message 'Refund marked as transferred.' and call fetchData(), (e) on error: toast the error from err.response?.data?.error or fallback 'Failed to mark as transferred.', (f) finally: setTransferring(null).

Step 4 — Update actions column render to handle APPROVED status: The actions column currently only handles row.status === 'PENDING'. Extend it to also handle row.status === 'APPROVED' by returning a single 'Mark as Transferred' Button with variant='secondary', size='sm', loading={transferring === row.id}, onClick={() => handleMarkTransferred(row)}. TRANSFERRED and REJECTED rows return null (no actions).
acceptance_criteria: Refunds page renders without console errors
TRANSFERRED refunds display an info-variant badge
PENDING refunds show Approve + Reject buttons (unchanged)
APPROVED refunds show a 'Mark as Transferred' button that shows a loading spinner while the request is in flight
Clicking 'Mark as Transferred' on an APPROVED refund calls PUT /api/admin/refunds/:id/transferred and refreshes the table on success
TRANSFERRED and REJECTED refunds show no action buttons
verification: Start the Vite dev server: 'cd client && npm run dev' — confirm no compile errors
Open the admin Refunds page in the browser — confirm no console errors
Confirm TRANSFERRED badge renders with info variant by inspecting a TRANSFERRED refund row
Confirm APPROVED refund row shows 'Mark as Transferred' button
Click 'Mark as Transferred' and confirm the API call is made and the table refreshes
findings: All 4 steps implemented in Refunds.jsx: TRANSFERRED added to statusVariant map with info variant; transferring useState added; handleMarkTransferred handler added (confirm dialog → PUT /api/admin/refunds/:id/transferred → success toast + fetchData, error toast, finally clears state); actions column extended to render Mark as Transferred button for APPROVED rows. Vite build passes cleanly with 0 errors.
